emotional_impression: I don't know what to do yet—but I know where to start. Welcoming, organized, scholarly but warm. Not an official hospital site.

fonts.usage: H1, H2, large quotes. Conveys scholarly trust and scientific journaling.
Paragraphs, standard buttons, form inputs. Highly legible, subtle technical feel.
Tags, dates, breadcrumbs, 'Step 01' indicators, small caps overlines. Enhances the laboratory/scientific vibe.

colors.theme_preference: Light mode default. Academic ink-and-paper feel.
rules: NO purple/violet gradients. NO generic tech-blue.
NO stark #000000 black, use the warm ink (#2A2B2A).
Use sage as the primary interactive/brand color.
Use terracotta for warnings, highlights, or the 'I need support' pathway to draw attention.

motifs: Graph Paper/Hemocytometer Grid: Use subtle 1px border grids (`border-ink/10`) in hero and bento backgrounds.
Crosshairs: Use '+' icons at the intersections of grid lines to mimic microscope reticles.
Lens Cutouts: Use perfect circles or pill shapes (`rounded-full`) for image masks or icon containers to evoke looking through a lens.
Compass/Navigation: Use subtle directional arrows or a minimalist compass rose as watermarks.
visual_enhancers.cards: Flat surfaces with 1px border (`border-ink/10`), no heavy drop shadows. `rounded-2xl` for friendliness. On hover, translate up slightly and change border color to Sage or Terracotta.
visual_enhancers.icons: Use `lucide-react` with `strokeWidth={1.5}`. Key icons: Compass, Microscope, TestTube, BookOpen, HeartPulse.

Home.hero: Asymmetrical layout. Large serif 'MLS COMPASS'. Subtitle in sans. Background features a faint grid and a circular 'lens' revealing a lab image.
Home.pathways: Bento grid of 4 cards (I'm New to MLS, I Need Resources, I Need Support, I Have a Question). Each gets a distinct mono index (01, 02...) and a dedicated icon.
Home.quick_links: Clean horizontal list or editorial scrolling marquee (`react-fast-marquee`).

First-Year Roadmap.layout: Vertical timeline. Instead of standard dots, use stylized 'cell division' nodes or chemical bond lines. 5 distinct stages.
First-Year Roadmap.stages: Use Shadcn accordion for 'Common Freshman Questions' at the bottom of the timeline.

Resource Hub.layout: Categorized bento grids. Sticky sidebar for categories (Academic, Lab, Student Documents, Student Life, Useful Links) with smooth scroll to sections.
Resource Hub.cards: Cards have a technical 'document' feel with mono-font tags.

Student Support.layout: Warmest page on the site. Use more Terracotta accents.
Student Support.components: 'Are We Okay?' section is a prominent card featuring the embedded Google Form placeholder. Official support links should look authoritative but not intimidating.

Ask MLS.layout: Two-column split. Left: Large serif quote and submission form. Right: 'Things I Wish I Knew Before MLS' quote cards styled like physical flashcards or lab notes.

Admin Panel.layout: Clean, high-density dashboard. Table view for FAQs and Quotes. Use Shadcn datatable. Keep it strictly functional.

components_and_libraries.ui_library: shadcn/ui primitives. Customize heavily: remove default card shadows, use flat borders.
components_and_libraries.motion: framer-motion for page transitions and card hovers. lenis for smooth scrolling (crucial for editorial feel).
components_and_libraries.forms: Embed Google Forms using `<iframe src='...'>` inside stylized Shadcn Card wrappers to hide the clunky Google styling where possible.

image_urls.description: Group of students in lab coats. Warm lighting, relatable. Use in Home Hero or Resource Hub.
Green abstract cellular structure. Use as a subtle background texture (low opacity) behind cards or hero.
Students studying in library. Good for Resource Hub or First-Year roadmap.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 ratio. The warm ink (#2A2B2A) on base background (#F9F8F6) exceeds this easily.
accessibility_and_testing.testing: CRITICAL: All interactive elements MUST have `data-testid` attributes (e.g., `data-testid="nav-home-link"`, `data-testid="faq-accordion-trigger"`).

instructions_to_main_agent: Use JavaScript (.js/.jsx), NOT TypeScript (.tsx) for React components.
Do NOT use HTML components for dropdowns, date pickers, or complex interactions; rely strictly on Shadcn UI.
Do NOT center-align the main app container in CSS. Left-align text by default, center only for specific visual rhythm in hero/headers.
Avoid generic 'AI slop' gradients or emojis. Use Phosphor or Lucide icons only.
Use generous spacing (p-8 to p-16) to achieve the editorial magazine look.
For the header, use a semi-solid or glassmorphism background (`backdrop-blur-md bg-white/80`). NEVER leave the header completely transparent over scrolling content.
Mock the Google Form embeds using generic `<iframe src='...'>` blocks within nicely styled cards.
Implement light mode as the default. This is an academic site, so 'paper' white is ideal.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Avoid generic, 'on distribution' outputs (no AI slop).
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and glass-morphism.
MUST NOT apply universal transitions (e.g., `transition: all`). Target specific properties.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Use subtle grain textures and custom cursors if applicable.
Do NOT use placeholder image URLs (via.placeholder.com). Use only provided unsplash links.
Include `data-testid` on all buttons, links, inputs, and major UI components.
